title: Spirit Fill Level Depletion Rate
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spirit:bottle spirit_type=* fill_level_pct=*
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats current=f last(fill_level_pct) as prev_fill by bottle_id
| eval depletion_pct=round(prev_fill-fill_level_pct,1)
| where depletion_pct>5
| stats avg(depletion_pct) as avg_depletion, count as pours by spirit_type bottle_id
| sort - avg_depletion
description: Tracks how quickly spirits bottle fill levels drop between inventory scans.
value: Depletion rate shows which bottles get enjoyed versus collect dust, guiding repurchase and gift decisions.
implementation: Log `fill_level_pct` on periodic spirit inventory scans and compare pour frequency by bottle.
visualization: Bar chart of average depletion percent by spirit type.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which bottles you are actually drinking down versus letting sit full.
